messages.signIn: One authSignInFailed for wrong password, nonexistent account and equivalent credential failures.
messages.emailUnavailable: Neutral operation failure; no account existence confirmation.
messages.tooManyAttempts: No duration, retry-after, threshold or attempt counter in user copy. Existing backend eligibility remains authority.
messages.reauth: Only actual existing auth reauthentication-required result; no new session-age rule.
messages.resetSent: Same conditional registered-if-sent message for registered and unregistered address results; real offline/request failures retain their error state.
